pr_title: feat(installer): retry download if connection is interrupted
pr_comments: Why is it specific to ECONRESET?

> Why is it specific to ECONRESET?

@yury-s this is the only error we see so far that's worth a retry. Dmitry also mentioned `ETIMEDOUT` (e.g. [here](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/5188/checks?check_run_id=1780326604)), but I think this happens since our jobs are often interrupted on Mac 11 (there's mac11 shortage on gh)

issue_context.title: [BUG] Lock not released in case of ECONNRESET when installing
comments: @alexdima awesome investigation! I've adopted your snippet code into Playwright to run download re-tries.

@alexdima so the fix has landed and is available at the `playwright@next` channel. We'll be happy if you can test this out and see if it makes things better for you. If it doesn't, please feel free to open a new issue to bring our attention to it! (we often miss notifications to the closed issues but are very carefully triaging all the incoming bugs).

review_comments: Why not try/catch instead? Are you sure we are not getting errors anywhere else? Like, from fs.createWriteStream for example?
there's a try-catch around to handle this case. We don't want to re-try in case of write stream error though since it's hard to predict consequences.
